files.doc: UFS 3-701-01 DoD Facilities Pricing Guide (6 June 2026)
UFC 3-701-01 DoD Facilities Pricing Guide, Change 7 (25 July 2025)

source.caveat: DoD unit costs reflect military construction standards (for example, minimum antiterrorism features) and are intended for planning-level estimates, not individual project estimates.
includes: Building to the 5-foot line (standard foundations, envelope, interiors, MEP, built-in equipment)
Site: fine grading, surface parking paving and striping, concrete walks, topsoil, sod and irrigation (DoD Table 6 unit costs)
excludes: Site utilities beyond 5 ft, storm drainage, site lighting, retaining walls and mass earthwork (add with the utilities allowance)
Furniture, IT and equipment from other funds
